label: AD&D 2nd Edition (quotable law: For Gold & Glory; official scans local-only)

d20_states.note: 2e has no advantage machinery; d20_state modifiers are refused with a note

hp_from_hd.note: monster HD are d8 (FG&G fgg-text p0309, printed 299); '12+24' reads 12d8+24; 1/2 HD = 2d2 (fgg-text p0293, printed 283 — audit cbt A-1/court-fgg 2026-06-06); 1/4 mapping unwitnessed in FG&G — provisional

attack.notes: descending AC: you hit AC (THAC0 − roll); nat 20/1 auto rules per FG&G; RAW 2e has no critical damage effect (crit_effect: none) — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0065 (printed 55, THACO procedure: modified d20 >= THAC0−AC, mods roll-side); p0074 (printed 64, nat 1 auto-failure); p0075 (printed 65, nat 20 auto-hit, no damage effect)

save.notes: save targets come from the class/HD matrices — law (Mechanus/caller supplies the target number) — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0069 (printed 59, procedure 1d20+mods >= save score); p0070 (printed 60, five categories in priority order; bonuses modify the die roll, not the target)

ability.notes: roll-under: succeed by rolling your ability score or less; nat 1 always succeeds, nat 20 always fails (matters when modified targets exit the die range) — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0014 (printed 4, glossary: 1d20 <= ability score succeeds); p0045 (printed 35, chapter-6 check law incl. the nat-1/nat-20 auto rules) — audit A-1-2e-04

proficiency.notes: nonweapon proficiency: roll-under ability, check modifier adjusts the target (positive = easier); nat 1 always succeeds, nat 20 always fails — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0045 (printed 35, skill-check law: roll-under; positive modifiers raise the score — the add_to_target direction; Advanced +3/Mastery +6) — audit A-1-2e-06

thief_skill.notes: roll-under percentile vs the final adjusted skill % (caller passes the modified pct) — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0035 (printed 25, Table 3.15 base %, 95% cap, <1% unusable); p0036 (printed 26, 96-100 auto-springs traps — high roll fails)

percent.notes: roll <= percentage succeeds — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0070 (printed 60, percentile direction via magic resistance); p0015 (printed 5, d% law, two 0s = 100)

morale.notes: holds if 2d10 <= morale rating (A'kin: champion (16)) — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0073 (printed 63, MORALE + Tables 8.11/8.12); p0074 (printed 64, procedure: 2d10 <= rating holds). Table 8.12 modifiers adjust the RATING — pass the modified rating as the morale param

reaction.notes: FG&G Table 10.7 (fgg-text p0094, printed 84) is a 2D cross-reference: 2d10 + Cha reaction adjustment, read against the PARTY's disposition column (friendly/indifferent/threatening/hostile; default indifferent, disclosed). Six outcomes incl. flight. Replaces the audit-condemned flat provisional bands (A-1-2e-10, court-fgg 2026-06-06).

surprise.notes: 1-3 on d10 = surprised; situational mods are law — FG&G cite: fgg-text p0093 (printed 83, 1d10, 1-3 = surprised); p0094 (printed 84, Table 10.8 surprise modifiers, roll-side)

initiative.notes: low wins, parties act ascending (FG&G fgg-text p0065, printed 55); casting time adds to the roll (p0066, printed 56; worked example p0074, printed 64); weapon combat speed breaks TIES only (p0057, printed 47 definition; p0065, printed 55 procedure) — it never adds. PHB-style speed-adds belongs in a disclosed house overlay (data/overrides/2e.json). Audit A-1-2e-13.

encounter_doctrine.note: wandering-encounter doctrine; module set-pieces usually skip 'check' and 'table'; morale arms (never pre-rolls)
